summary: Axia Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K detailing the redemption and/or conversion of its Class C preferred shares (PNCs) into common shares. Created on December 19, 2025, each PNC was distributed at a ratio of 0.262837887 per common/Class A1/B1 share, redeemable or convertible by 2031, with one share/one vote and equal dividends. On June 5, 2026, PNA1 and PNB1 shares were converted during a migration to Novo Mercado. This capital return event reduces share classes and may simplify capital structure. Watch for shareholder uptake and potential dilution effects on common equity.
